name: Simply Irresistible
body:
Prerequisite(s): Int or Wis 15, 1st-level culinarian.

Benefit(s): You can throw a full meal you created at a space up to 10 feet from you. When it lands, enemies that can smell the meal spend their next move action moving toward it. A successful Will save at the meal’s DC negates this effect. Creatures that would draw an attack of opportunity or be put in harm’s way by this effect get a +5 to their saving throw.
